summary.text: Jayme Davis is a Democratic state representative from North Dakota who has served in the House since December 2024 and is the Democratic candidate for North Dakota State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a tribal policy specialist.

paragraphs.text: Davis earned a B.S. in business management from the University of Mary in 2011.

Her career experience includes working as a legal department administrator and policy specialist for the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa, as CEO of Circle of Nations Consulting, and as a program director with the Native Governance Center.
Davis won a special general election for North Dakota House District 9 on November 5, 2024, and assumed office on December 1, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her on the House Human Services Committee and the House Political Subdivisions Committee for 2023-2024.
On June 9, 2026, she defeated incumbent Richard Marcellais in the Democratic primary for State Senate District 9, 68.9 percent to 30.9 percent.
